meta.title: Spatial Intelligence Atlas
meta.subtitle: Tourism, Risk & Decision Systems
meta.notice: Three research cases and one supporting instrument. Documented separately — never integrated, combined, or ranked.
meta.provenance: Every field below is drawn from the pinned, commit-referenced primary sources listed in the sources section, reviewed on the recorded reviewed_at dates. Inputs, status, and outcomes are separate: real input does not establish validation or decision sufficiency.

input_kinds.label: OBSERVED
input_kinds.definition: Direct observation recorded for the bounded study or test.

input_kinds.label: ACQUIRED
input_kinds.definition: Existing real-world data obtained from a declared external source.

input_kinds.label: DERIVED
input_kinds.definition: Produced from other records through a declared transformation.

input_kinds.label: SIMULATED
input_kinds.definition: Produced by a model under stated assumptions or conditions.

input_kinds.label: REPORTED
input_kinds.definition: Supplied as a report or assertion rather than directly observed by the project.

input_kinds.label: UNESTABLISHED
input_kinds.definition: The reviewed sources do not establish an input kind.

entities.label: HATI — Pedestrian Heat Extension
entities.role: Frozen robustness case for evidence-first pedestrian heat comparison.
entities.research_question: Across the two frozen Atocha–Puerta de Alcalá routes and tested departure times, does the modelled thermal evidence remain strong enough under justified canopy-vintage and side-of-street perturbations to establish either route as robustly cooler?

entities.label: SNTO — PNSG Decision Evidence
entities.role: Bounded destination-management case using environmental and governance evidence.
entities.research_question: With the evidence currently ingested, which PNSG public-use units, if any, justify priority management review or monitoring for the 2027 planning cycle, and where is evidence insufficient to establish priority?

entities.label: CHALUS — Western Mazandaran Pilot
entities.research_question: Do paired January and route-bounded June 2024 historical-network reconstructions meet the pre-registered verification standard required before Earth-observation processing and any later tourism-accessibility claim?

entities.label: FieldOS
entities.role: Offline-first supporting instrument for structured tourism field evidence capture.

territories.label: Madrid — Atocha to Puerta de Alcalá
territories.basis: The HATI extension freezes two candidate pedestrian routes between Atocha and Puerta de Alcalá.

territories.label: Parque Nacional de la Sierra de Guadarrama
territories.basis: The SNTO decision brief concerns PNSG public-use units and the 2027 planning cycle.

territories.label: Western Mazandaran — Chalus, Nowshahr and Kelardasht
territories.basis: CHALUS evaluates three destinations from south, east and west gateways for the June 2024 event context.

evidence_records.label: Modelled two-route thermal comparison
evidence_records.basis: A modelled two-route thermal comparison was stress-tested at two departure times against justified canopy-source-vintage and side-of-street perturbations.
evidence_records.limitation: The ensemble does not establish observed pedestrian exposure, health, safety, preference, or a robust route winner.

evidence_records.label: Sentinel-2 campaign coverage
evidence_records.basis: Real Sentinel-2 observations cover 21 PNSG campaign assets from January 2021 through June 2026.
evidence_records.limitation: Satellite vegetation signal is environmental context, not visitor pressure, tourism impact, or causal attribution.

evidence_records.label: Derived vegetation trends
evidence_records.basis: NDVI/NDMI/EVI series and Mann–Kendall/Sen results are derived per asset; six assets green, fourteen show no trend, and one declines significantly.
evidence_records.limitation: Derived environmental trends do not establish trail condition, ecological impact, or cause.

evidence_records.label: PRUG protection zoning
evidence_records.basis: Official PNSG PRUG protection zoning is available as a real management layer.
evidence_records.limitation: Zoning is not evidence of visitor volume, condition, or impact.

evidence_records.label: No visitor-use evidence
evidence_records.basis: No visitor-use evidence exists at asset or trail scale in the reviewed source set.
evidence_records.limitation: Without a matching use denominator, a physical-intervention priority cannot be established.

evidence_records.label: January OSM source recovery
evidence_records.basis: The January OSM binary source was recovered by recorded SHA-256 and used with the bounded June reconstruction inputs.
evidence_records.limitation: OSM-attested network state is not independent confirmation that decisive motorway sections were operational at the historical cutoff.

evidence_records.label: Paired retrospective route reconstruction
evidence_records.basis: Paired retrospective networks produced reproducible modelled distances for nine gateway–destination pairs and eighteen route states; the maximum January–June difference was 0.011%.
evidence_records.limitation: Numeric stability alone does not satisfy the pre-registered historical-verification standard.

evidence_records.label: Unresolved historical verification
evidence_records.basis: Full Haraz correspondence, complete June turn restrictions, and independent decisive-motorway operational status were not established.
evidence_records.limitation: These gaps trigger the frozen no-go rule regardless of the stable modelled distances.

evidence_records.label: First iPhone field run
evidence_records.basis: One 60–120 minute offline field workflow on a physical iPhone completed on 2026-08-31; tested capture, close/reopen persistence, export, and backup passed with no intended data loss reported.
evidence_records.limitation: The result is one first-party session without independent audit; observation counts, exact duration, device/OS details, timing metrics, and storage-pressure results were not recorded.

evidence_records.label: No Android test run
evidence_records.basis: No physical Android test had been run at the reviewed commit.

outcomes.statement: ABSTAIN / NO ROBUST DIFFERENCE: the route-difference sign reversed under at least one justified perturbation at both tested departure times and the ensemble spanned zero.
outcomes.claim_ceiling: Neither route is established as cooler, preferred, accurate, comfortable, behaviourally superior, physiologically safer, lower-dose, or healthier; the result does not mean the routes are thermally identical.

outcomes.statement: Evidence is insufficient to prioritise any physical intervention, closure, quota, restoration, or budget commitment; monitoring and improved data collection are the proportionate actions.
outcomes.claim_ceiling: No asset/trail visitor volume, tourism causality, ground condition, ecological impact, monetary allocation, closure, or restriction claim is supported.

outcomes.statement: GATE 2A-R CLOSED — NO-GO: the historical-verification standard was not met, so Earth-observation processing and Gate 2B remain unauthorised.
outcomes.claim_ceiling: The case does not establish tourist delay, cancellations, demand, revenue loss, destination resilience, infrastructure investment need, or a verified historical motorway-operability claim.

outcomes.statement: One owner-attested iPhone field workflow passed the executed offline capture-to-backup checks with no intended data loss reported.
outcomes.claim_ceiling: FieldOS is not thereby validated, production-ready, field-proven across conditions, independently audited, or cross-platform verified.
